title: Sponsors; responsibilities.
bodyHtml:
[§471-9.7]  Sponsors; responsibilities.  For the purposes of this chapter and rules adopted by the board, a sponsor shall be responsible for:

     (1)  Determining the level of supervision required for the sponsored individual;

     (2)  The veterinary care given to the animal patient by the sponsored individual;

     (3)  Ensuring that the board has been notified in writing; and

     (4)  Confirming that the sponsored individual has obtained the appropriate courtesy permit or relief permit from the board. [L 2022, c 71, pt of §1]
